title: fetch_session maps URL join failure to InvalidArgument — wrong variant
description: In fetch_session: self.base_url.join(".well-known/jmap").map_err(|e| ClientError::InvalidArgument(...)). The base_url was already validated by JmapClient::new to have http/https scheme and no path/query/fragment. url::Url::join with a valid base and the literal string ".well-known/jmap" cannot fail. If it ever did, it would be an internal bug, not an invalid caller argument. The error should be InvalidSession (server-side unreachable) or an unreachable!() macro. Using InvalidArgument implies the caller passed a bad argument, which is misleading since base_url was already accepted by the constructor.
